_about: Wording corrected after checking against search results (see data/verification_pilot.json). Applied by tools/clean_data.py. Each entry replaces one field of one record.

storm-king-art-center.why_flagged: Bloomberg Philanthropies is listed in Storm King's 2025 donor list in the Ambassador tier ($100,000+).

casa-frança-brasil-rio-de-janeiro.why_flagged: The former Casa França-Brasil now operates as Casa Brasil, with Petrobras as sponsor through its Novos Eixos call (Ícones da Cultura Brasileira line). The rename date is not confirmed.

state-tretyakov-gallery-moscow.watch: Director Zelfira Tregulova removed 9 Feb 2023 after a Ministry-forwarded complaint of 'destructive ideology'. The Ministry cancelled the 9th Moscow Biennale on 3 Nov 2022.

frye-art-museum.watch: The museum laid off 21 part-time and on-call workers on 10 April 2020. The Art Workers Union picketed that day, saying two of its bargaining-committee members were targeted, and petitioned for reinstatement. Director Joseph Rosa said union membership had no bearing on the lay-offs.

seattle-art-museum-seattle.funding: Expenses $44.4M (FY2025 Form 990). Institutional partners on the corporate-support page archived 26 May 2026 include Amazon, Alaska Airlines and Bloomberg Philanthropies.
seattle-art-museum-seattle.why_flagged: Boeing and Honeywell, both US defence contractors, are named as institutional partners on the museum's corporate-support page.
seattle-art-museum-seattle.watch: In January 2022 Decolonize SAM, an anonymous staff collective, called for a boycott over stone bollards installed in June 2021 and private guards hired to keep unhoused people off the museum grounds. The museum said the guards were hired after violent incidents around the building.
